diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia
legend: Densely packed endometrial glands with little intervening stroma, forming a lesion.

diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia
legend: The nuclear and cytoplasmic features of the crowded glands differ from those of the entrapped non-atypical gland in the centre. Cellular atypia is characterized by loss of polarity of the glandular epithelium. The nuclei are irregularly distributed, enlarged, and often vesicular, or they may show distinct nucleoli.

diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia with secretory changes
legend: The crowded glands show secretory changes, similar to early secretory-phase endometrium. The lesion is distinct from adjacent non-lesional glands, which lack these extensive secretory changes.

diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia with secretory changes
legend: The atypical glands are characterized by extensive cytoplasmic clearing and enlarged, irregularly distributed nuclei, frequently with distinct nucleoli.

diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia
legend: The atypical gland with enlarged, irregularly distributed, round to oval nuclei (left) is distinct from an adjacent non-lesional gland with smaller, elongated, and pseudostratified nuclei (right).

diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia with secretory changes
legend: A lesion consisting of crowded glands with cytoplasmic clearing, distinct from a few adjacent non-lesional glands (top left and right).

diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia
legend: The geographical region of this endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia lesion is visible at low magnification: its architecture shows aggregates of glands that exceed the volume of stroma.

diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia
legend: Within the crowded focus, the nuclear and cytoplasmic features of the atypical glands differ from those of the low-density background glands.
